d:
What happens when young students get a say in a custom motorcycle design? The OCC team takes inspiration from sketches submitted by Nana Glen Primary, working to turn the drawings into real sheet-metal details while keeping the bike's controls and proportions practical.
This build is about more than creative looks. It also involves preparing specialist workshop equipment for an overseas setup and considering the requirements of Australian roads. See the ideas take shape on American Chopper Season 4 Episode 100, only on discovery+ India.
